officialSources.observation: Official Xinyang government notice says online services provide visual cadastral/property consistency and access to natural-condition and cadastral-map information through the natural-resources authority. It is institutional/procedure evidence, not an open parcel API.

Official Xinyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau registration section documents the local registration center and service procedures. No anonymous parcel layer, schema or CRS was exposed in the accessible content.
Official Xinyang property-registration portal loaded and visibly exposes a 地籍图公示 cadastral-map publicity service. The linked map route is access-controlled and did not yield public parcel geometry.
